plan.title: Invoice Reconciliation Demo
workflow_steps: Upload batch of invoices and purchase orders
Intake agent parses and normalises documents
Matching agent compares invoice line items against POs
Exception agent flags mismatches above 2% or missing POs
Summary agent drafts an email to the AP manager
User reviews exceptions, approves or rejects, and downloads report

demo_agents.name: intake_agent
demo_agents.role: Parse and normalise uploaded invoices and POs

demo_agents.name: matching_agent
demo_agents.role: Compare invoice line items against POs by item code, quantity and price

demo_agents.name: exception_agent
demo_agents.role: Flag mismatches above 2% variance or missing POs

demo_agents.name: summary_agent
demo_agents.role: Draft reconciliation summary email to AP manager

demo_tools.name: parse_document
demo_tools.purpose: Extract structured data from invoice or PO

demo_tools.name: compare_line_items
demo_tools.purpose: Diff two lists of line items

success_criteria: All 20 invoices are parsed and matched against POs
Exceptions above 2% variance are flagged automatically
Missing PO cases are identified and listed
User can approve or reject each exception
Audit log records every agent action and tool call
assumptions: Documents are pre-converted to structured JSON for the demo (no OCR)
Vendor IDs are consistent between invoices and POs

html_sim.reason: The workflow is deterministic and sequential, fitting a single-page step-through simulation
